title: What is a Classic Load Balancer?
note: Lesson 2.1 addition for task 2.1 questions (K09, distractor for q-saa-2-1-k09-mc): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com and confirmed the Classic Load Balancer is the previous generation of Elastic Load Balancing, whose listed benefits (TCP/SSL listeners, application-generated-cookie sticky sessions) do not include path- or host-based routing, which requires an Application Load Balancer.
